jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Computer Vision
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer with strong foundations in computer vision and  
  
machine learning, and a practical mindset: you care about making models work on real data, in  
  
real products. Our team builds foundational perception technologies. These models are built  
  
once and reused by many experiences, across iPhone, iPad, Mac, HomeView and more. They  
  
already power Apple Intelligence features such as Visual Intelligence and Clean Up in Photos.  
  
Our work spans a wide range of models, from lightweight, task-specific vision models to  
  
general-purpose vision-language models. In this role, you will build computer vision models and  
  
VLMs that help Apple devices recognize and understand the objects around the user. You will  
  
turn recent research into models that ship on millions of devices.  
  
**Description**  
  
Design, train and improve computer vision and VLM models for object understanding and  
  
recognition.  
  
Make models robust to real-world conditions and across devices and fix failure modes on real  
  
data  
  
Define evaluations that reflect product quality, and use them to drive model decisions.  
  
Design models for on-device constraints (memory, latency, power).  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  
Publications in top computer vision or machine learning venues (CVPR, ICCV, ECCV,  
  
NeurIPS, ICLR), ideally with released code or work transferred to a product.  
  
Experience in representation learning, such as self-supervised learning, metric learning,  
  
retrieval or recognition.  
  
Experience applying machine learning in an industry or product setting.  
  
Experience with knowledge distillation or model compression.  
  
Familiarity with vision-language models.  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**  
  
Ph.D. or Master's in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Vision or a related field,  
  
or equivalent industry experience.  
  
Strong foundations in computer vision and deep learning.  
  
Track record of making models work in practice: end-to-end projects covering data, training  
  
and evaluation on real-world visual data.  
  
Proficiency in Python and PyTorch or an equivalent deep learning framework.  
  
Proficiency in using generative coding tools  
  
Rigorous experimentation: clear baselines, ablations and meaningful evaluation sets.  
  
**Pay & Benefits**  
  
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $150,400 and $277,600, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  
  
Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses - including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits  
  
Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

jobs.title: Data Scientist , Music DISCO
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections between fans, artists, and creators. From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts, concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting intersections of music and culture. We offer experiences that serve all listeners with our different tiers of service: Prime members get access to all the music in shuffle mode, and top ad-free podcasts, included with their membership; customers can upgrade to Amazon Music Unlimited for unlimited, on-demand access to 100 million songs, including millions in HD, Ultra HD, and spatial audio; and anyone can listen for free by downloading the Amazon Music app or via Alexa-enabled devices. Join us for the opportunity to influence how Amazon Music engages fans, artists, and creators on a global scale.  
  
The Data, Insights, Science and Optimization, Consumer Product and Tech (DISCO CPT) team is looking for a Data Scientist to join a team of Data Scientists, Analytics Leads, Business Intelligence Engineers and Data Engineers who analyze big data, provide analytics and insights as well as build models and algorithms that power product for personalized experiences. The team focuses on accelerating Amazon Music customer growth by empowering Product teams to make sound, customer-centric decisions through data and insights. We build data pipelines, science models, self-service analytics, insights and dashboards, deliver engagement and retention at scale. In this role, you will pioneer and execute advanced analytics and experimentation efforts for the Amazon Music product team. You will work with stakeholders and partners to deliver experimentation insights, author scientific artifacts, build scalable models to advance our analytics and science products. The ideal candidate must be willing to effectively lead science solutions, prioritize across multiple stakeholders and projects and be ready to jump into a fast-paced, dynamic and fun environment.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
1. Data Scientist I on this role will be a thought partner to Product and Engineering organizations through their expertise in experimentation, statistical modeling and advanced analytics  
2. Conceptualize and drive strategic growth areas: app performance, stablity and latency experimentation, Gen AI initiatives, and product excellence.  
3. Bridge science, analytics, and engineering to deliver solutions informing strategic decisions on AM technology investments and long-term business performance  
4. Drive experimentation, measurement efficiency tooling, and ROI tracking for AM leadership  
5. Build and maintain causal models to understand customer sentiment and its impact on key engagement/retention metrics  
6. Develop structural and predictive models using data science workflows to deliver measurable customer results  
  
A day in the life  
1. Lead strategic initiatives across visual and voice experiences, experimentation and customer retention stakeholders  
2. Conduct experimentation, build causal models to better understand key drivers for customer retention  
3. Evaluate existing metrics and lead deep dives to ensure the right measurement framework is leveraged to measure and enhance user adoption through visual and voice interfaces  
4. Partner with product managers to translate business questions into actionable science projects  
5. Influence product roadmaps through data-driven insights on customer behavior patterns  
6. Identify and resolve customer experience friction points with cross-functional teams  
Drive adoption of best practices and innovative solutions across the organization

* 2+ years of data/research scientist, statistician or quantitative analyst in an internet-based company with complex and big data sources experience
* 1+ years of creating or contributing to mathematical textbooks, research papers, or educational content experience
* Master's degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM), or experience working in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM)

jobs.title: ML Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.  
  
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

**ML INFRASTRUCTURE ENGINEER**

As an ML Infrastructure Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in building and optimizing the reliable, high-performance ML platform that powers recommendations on X. We're looking for exceptional engineers who are passionate about our mission and have a strong desire to make a meaningful impact.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Designing, building, and scaling GPU compute infrastructure, training frameworks, and experimentation tools to enable rapid iteration on ML hypotheses
* Developing data pipelines and integrating large-scale data, training, and inference systems
* Collaborating with ML teams to productionize models and ensure seamless integration across the stack
* Ensuring scalability, reliability, and efficiency of large-scale machine learning systems
* Working across the full stack to solve complex problems independently
* Mentoring junior engineers and contributing to the growth of the team

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's, master's, post-graduate, or Ph.D. degree in computer science, machine learning, or other quantitative discipline
* 2+ years of industry experience working with high traffic or large-scale production environments, distributed systems, GPU infrastructure, and/or deep learning applications
* 2+ years experience with ML platforms, training infrastructure, or close collaboration with modeling engineers and data scientists
* Experience with Python and compiled languages such as C++ or Rust

**PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Deep familiarity with modern ML frameworks such as JAX or PyTorch
* Low-level understanding of compute systems, including distributed storage, NVIDIA drivers, CUDA toolkits, and networking
* Comfortable with Linux systems and orchestration tools
* Experience with job schedulers (e.g., Slurm), configuration management (Puppet/Ansible), or related infrastructure tooling

**COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:**

$180,000 - $440,000 USD

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

*SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our* *Recruitment Privacy Notice**.*

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Applications
jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

We are a well-funded, early-stage AI research and product lab focused on building the next generation of frontier multimodal AI models. Founded by former DeepMind researchers—including Andrew Dai, previously an engineering leader on Gemini—our mission is to push the frontier of visual and multimodal intelligence. Our first model, Glimpse, launched publicly in October 2026.

Our team currently consists of 25 world-class scientists and engineers. We raised a $55M seed round led by Altimeter Capital, Menlo Ventures, Striker VC, and NVIDIA. We are tackling foundational problems in artificial intelligence and translating cutting-edge multimodal research into scalable, real-world systems.

**About The Role**
------------------

As a **Software Engineer – Applications**, you will build the engineering bridge between our core multimodal research and real-world production deployments. This is an engineering-first, high-impact role where you will design and implement reference architectures, production-grade integration frameworks, developer SDKs, evaluation harnesses, and bespoke end-to-end applications powered by Glimpse.

You will sit at the intersection of product engineering, model evaluation, and customer architecture. Working directly with founders, early enterprise partners, and our internal research team, you will turn complex multimodal requirements into robust, high-performance systems and feed real-world constraints directly into our model roadmaps.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

* **Architect & Build Production Integrations:** Design, build, and deploy low-latency, scalable application architectures integrating Glimpse into complex enterprise data pipelines and high-throughput workflows.
* **Develop Reference Systems & Tooling:** Create open-source reference implementations, production-ready demo applications, developer tooling, and SDK components that establish the standard for building on Glimpse.
* **Build Evaluation & Benchmarking Infrastructure:** Design and implement rigorous evaluation pipelines and benchmarking harnesses to systematically test Glimpse against other frontier multimodal models on diverse, real-world visual datasets.
* **Debug Across the Stack:** Systematically isolate and resolve bottlenecks across application pipelines, data ingestion layers, model inference APIs, and prompt/orchestration logic.
* **Partner Technically with Early Adopters:** Serve as the core technical architect for engineering teams at design-partner companies, guiding technical discovery, proof-of-concept development, and deployment to production.
* **Influence Model & Platform Roadmaps:** Translate real-world application failure modes, edge cases, and performance requirements into prioritized specifications for our core research and model infrastructure teams.

**What We Are Looking For**
---------------------------

* **Strong Core Engineering:** 5+ years of experience building and shipping high-performance, production software in Python (and ideally TypeScript or Go/Rust). You write clean, maintainable code and can speak deeply to your architectural decisions.
* **Hands-on LLM/Multimodal Application Engineering:** Experience building complex systems beyond basic API calls—such as agentic workflows, structured tool-use frameworks, model evaluation pipelines, or orchestration layers for vision-language models.
* **Model Understanding & Evaluation:** Hands-on experience evaluating, fine-tuning, or benchmarking ML models. You can systematically differentiate between model failure modes, pipeline errors, and data-quality issues.
* **Full-Lifecycle Ownership:** A builder mindset with a bias for shipping quickly. Experience as a founding engineer, startup core contributor, or forward-deployed engineer is highly valued.
* **Systems & Data Architecture:** Familiarity with modern cloud architecture, API design, vector/multimodal indexing, streaming protocols, and handling high-volume image/video data pipelines under tight latency and cost constraints.
* **Clear Technical Communication:** Ability to communicate complex architectural tradeoffs clearly to both internal research teams and external engineering leaders.

**Nice To Have**
----------------

* Prior experience at a foundation model provider, AI developer platform, or ML infrastructure company.
* Direct experience building multimodal applications in vision-heavy verticals (e.g., robotics, industrial automation, manufacturing, geospatial, medical imaging, or media production).
* Experience developing public developer APIs, open-source AI tooling, or developer ecosystems.

**Logistics**
-------------

* **Location:** On-site in Palo Alto, CA
* **Employment Type:** Full-time
* **Compensation**: $250,000 – $400,000 + significant equity + comprehensive health insurance and perks

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer - Applications
new_jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

We are a well-funded, early-stage AI research and product lab focused on building the next generation of frontier multimodal AI models. Founded by former DeepMind researchers—including Andrew Dai, previously an engineering leader on Gemini—our mission is to push the frontier of visual and multimodal intelligence. Our first model, Glimpse, launched publicly in October 2026.

Our team currently consists of 25 world-class scientists and engineers. We raised a $55M seed round led by Altimeter Capital, Menlo Ventures, Striker VC, and NVIDIA. We are tackling foundational problems in artificial intelligence and translating cutting-edge multimodal research into scalable, real-world systems.

**About The Role**
------------------

As a **Software Engineer – Applications**, you will build the engineering bridge between our core multimodal research and real-world production deployments. This is an engineering-first, high-impact role where you will design and implement reference architectures, production-grade integration frameworks, developer SDKs, evaluation harnesses, and bespoke end-to-end applications powered by Glimpse.

You will sit at the intersection of product engineering, model evaluation, and customer architecture. Working directly with founders, early enterprise partners, and our internal research team, you will turn complex multimodal requirements into robust, high-performance systems and feed real-world constraints directly into our model roadmaps.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

* **Architect & Build Production Integrations:** Design, build, and deploy low-latency, scalable application architectures integrating Glimpse into complex enterprise data pipelines and high-throughput workflows.
* **Develop Reference Systems & Tooling:** Create open-source reference implementations, production-ready demo applications, developer tooling, and SDK components that establish the standard for building on Glimpse.
* **Build Evaluation & Benchmarking Infrastructure:** Design and implement rigorous evaluation pipelines and benchmarking harnesses to systematically test Glimpse against other frontier multimodal models on diverse, real-world visual datasets.
* **Debug Across the Stack:** Systematically isolate and resolve bottlenecks across application pipelines, data ingestion layers, model inference APIs, and prompt/orchestration logic.
* **Partner Technically with Early Adopters:** Serve as the core technical architect for engineering teams at design-partner companies, guiding technical discovery, proof-of-concept development, and deployment to production.
* **Influence Model & Platform Roadmaps:** Translate real-world application failure modes, edge cases, and performance requirements into prioritized specifications for our core research and model infrastructure teams.

**What We Are Looking For**
---------------------------

* **Strong Core Engineering:** 5+ years of experience building and shipping high-performance, production software in Python (and ideally TypeScript or Go/Rust). You write clean, maintainable code and can speak deeply to your architectural decisions.
* **Hands-on LLM/Multimodal Application Engineering:** Experience building complex systems beyond basic API calls—such as agentic workflows, structured tool-use frameworks, model evaluation pipelines, or orchestration layers for vision-language models.
* **Model Understanding & Evaluation:** Hands-on experience evaluating, fine-tuning, or benchmarking ML models. You can systematically differentiate between model failure modes, pipeline errors, and data-quality issues.
* **Full-Lifecycle Ownership:** A builder mindset with a bias for shipping quickly. Experience as a founding engineer, startup core contributor, or forward-deployed engineer is highly valued.
* **Systems & Data Architecture:** Familiarity with modern cloud architecture, API design, vector/multimodal indexing, streaming protocols, and handling high-volume image/video data pipelines under tight latency and cost constraints.
* **Clear Technical Communication:** Ability to communicate complex architectural tradeoffs clearly to both internal research teams and external engineering leaders.

**Nice To Have**
----------------

* Prior experience at a foundation model provider, AI developer platform, or ML infrastructure company.
* Direct experience building multimodal applications in vision-heavy verticals (e.g., robotics, industrial automation, manufacturing, geospatial, medical imaging, or media production).
* Experience developing public developer APIs, open-source AI tooling, or developer ecosystems.

**Logistics**
-------------

* **Location:** On-site in Palo Alto, CA
* **Employment Type:** Full-time
* **Compensation**: $250,000 – $400,000 + significant equity + comprehensive health insurance and perks

new_jobs.title: Deep Learning Compiler Verification Engineer
new_jobs.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work.

  

We are building the next generation of compiler technologies to accelerate deep learning workloads. We are looking for an engineer to implement compiler verification software & related infrastructure in the AI space. You will be solving critical problems working alongside a diverse set of minds in GPU computing and systems software, doing what you enjoy. If this sounds like a fun challenge, we want to hear from you.

  

**What you'll be doing:**

* Develop and maintain components of systems to reason about correctness in deep learning compilers, across graph transformations, IR lowering, and GPU execution.
* Work with deep learning compiler and architecture teams to analyze and validate optimizations (e.g., graph rewrites in MLIR, fusion passes, mixed-precision transformations), ensuring they preserve semantics and numerical behavior.
* Implement and extend test generation systems that use deep learning solutions and analysis methods to drive in-depth testing. These systems explore the vast combinatorial space of model topologies, precision modes, and hardware targets.
Contribute to improving how we measure functional quality and performance as models, compiler stacks, and hardware continue to evolve.  

  

**What we need to see:**

* BS, MS or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent experience.
* 2+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with experience in compiler development, deep learning systems, or compiler verification.
* Proficiency in Python or C++ and experience with one major DL framework. This could be PyTorch, JAX/XLA, TensorRT, or a similar framework. Experience should involve model execution, graph representation, or runtime behavior.
Strong problem-solving and debugging skills — ability to reason about model behavior and compiler-generated code, investigate correctness issues, and collaborate with teammates to resolve edge-case failures.  

  

**Ways to stand out from the crowd:**

* Experience with compiler technologies such as LLVM, MLIR, TVM, or XLA, and familiarity with compiler passes, IR semantics, or correctness testing.
* Exposure to formal methods or language specification: type systems, program semantics, or proof-based verification.
* Experience with DL model internals such as quantization, operator fusion, mixed-precision, or graph-level optimization.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary range for this position is 116,000 USD – 189,750 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits .

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 4, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.
